nodes.question: How much waste is generated by industrial activities compared to municipal solid waste?
nodes.answer: Industrial activities generate a significant amount of waste that may exceed municipal solid waste by around 18 times.
nodes.paragraph: Companies are increasingly required to demonstrate their commitment to sustainable practices, reducing negative impacts on the environment and improving their social responsibility (Khaled et al. 2021).
